execution.method: collaboration subagents; fork_turns=none; no model or reasoning override
execution.settings: Inherited parent model and reasoning. Exact runtime identifiers, temperature, seed, and token accounting not exposed. Same requested configuration in both phases.
execution.isolation: Fresh agent per case and phase. Only supplied skill snapshot, prompt and CLI; exclude conversation, planning docs, other outputs and repository source. Instruction-scoped filesystem access, not sandbox-enforced.
execution.run_order: Original three runs before guidance edits; revised three after. At most three concurrent evaluators.
execution.evidence: Immutable draft.feature.md before validation; final.feature.md and generated final.openspec.md/final.feature separately. Log commands, exit codes, diagnostics and repairs. Parent reviews semantic rubric.

cases.prompt: Write a Markdown with Gherkin main specification for a library reservation service. An active member can reserve an available book. Cover exactly one behavior with one Rule and one Scenario: member M-17 is active, book B-42 is available, M-17 reserves B-42, and the reservation is confirmed for M-17 and B-42. Include a meaningful Feature description. Deliver the MDG document and its equivalent OpenSpec and plain Gherkin documents.
rubric: Main spec; one normative Rule and one Scenario; meaningful Feature description.
Active M-17 and available B-42 are preconditions; reservation action and confirmation identify both values.
No converter-domain behavior or unrequested descriptive tags.
Official validation and supported conversions succeed; one expanded case; normalized model preserved.

cases.prompt: Write a Markdown with Gherkin main specification for importing library catalog copies. Imports with a positive copies count are accepted; zero copies are rejected. Use one Rule and one Scenario Outline with two named Examples groups: Accepted has copies 1 and 2, both decision accepted; Rejected has copies 0 and decision rejected. In that outline, include a Given step with a two-column Data Table (field, value) holding shelf = A|B and source = C:\catalog (one literal backslash). Include a When step with a typed JSON Doc String containing copies as the numeric <copies> placeholder, shelf as the string A|B, and source as the string C:\catalog (one decoded backslash). The Then step checks <decision>. Preserve all literal values. Deliver the MDG document and its equivalent OpenSpec and plain Gherkin documents.
rubric: One normative Rule, one Outline, two named Examples groups, three expanded cases: 1 accepted, 2 accepted, 0 rejected.
Data Table has header field/value and exactly shelf=A|B, source=C:\catalog with one decoded backslash.
JSON media type; expanded Doc Strings parse with numeric copies, shelf=A|B, source=C:\catalog with one decoded backslash.
Steps cover import preconditions/action/outcomes and all placeholders bind; no converter-domain behavior.
Official validation and supported conversions succeed; normalized model preserved.

cases.prompt: Write a Markdown with Gherkin delta for a library circulation service with these operations, in this order: ADDED requirement "Renew a loan": an active member can renew a loan once; Scenario uses member M-17 and loan L-8 with zero previous renewals and confirms the new renewal count is 1. MODIFIED requirement "Reserve an available book": an active member with fewer than 3 current reservations can reserve an available book; Scenario uses M-17 with 2 reservations and book B-42, then confirms the reservation and a total of 3. REMOVED requirement "Fax reservation". RENAMED requirement "Loan audit" to "Circulation audit". Deliver the MDG delta and its equivalent OpenSpec and plain Gherkin documents.
rubric: Delta Feature marker and exactly one correct operation marker per Rule; order ADDED, MODIFIED, REMOVED, RENAMED.
Added and modified requirements normative; two Scenarios preserve supplied identifiers, eligibility and numeric outcomes.
Removal retains only Fax reservation identity; rename FROM Loan audit TO Circulation audit; no unsupported extra content.
Official validation and supported conversions succeed; two expanded cases; normalized model preserved.
